fullTextEN: Hello, I am Xika from Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 今天我要告诉你的故事叫《狐假虎威》。
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you a story called 'The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might'.

fullTextZH: 嗯，今天的故事有狐狸和老虎。
fullTextEN: Hmm, today's story has a fox and a tiger.

fullTextZH: 狐假虎威这四个字是中国成语。
fullTextEN: 'The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might' is a Chinese idiom.

fullTextZH: 成语这四个字不是很重要，
fullTextEN: The four characters of the idiom are not very important,

fullTextZH: 现在来看我画图说故事吧。
fullTextEN: Now let's watch me draw and tell the story.

fullTextZH: 就是有很多很多树的地方，
fullTextEN: which is a place with many, many trees,
there is a very big tiger.

fullTextZH: 其他的动物，像大象、猴子、兔子、小鸟，
fullTextEN: Other animals, like elephants, monkeys, rabbits, and birds,
they are all very afraid of the tiger.

fullTextZH: 有一天，老虎抓了一只狐狸。
fullTextEN: One day, the tiger caught a fox.

fullTextZH: 今天晚上我可以吃肉了。”

fullTextEN: But the fox is very clever.
It asked the tiger: "You want to eat me?
why should I be afraid of you?

fullTextZH: 狐狸说：“我不是普通的狐狸，
fullTextEN: The fox said: "I am not an ordinary fox,

fullTextZH: 我和其他的狐狸不一样，
fullTextEN: I am different from other foxes,
because I come from the sky,

fullTextZH: 我觉得你说的不是真的，
fullTextEN: I think what you said is not true,
It's fake, I don't believe it.
All the other animals are afraid of me,

fullTextZH: 因为它们知道我来自天上，
fullTextEN: because they know I come from the sky,
I am the fox of the gods.
The tiger watched the fox walk,

fullTextZH: 其他动物看到狐狸都很害怕，
fullTextEN: Other animals saw the fox and were very scared,
They are really afraid of the fox,
He really is a divine fox,
So the tiger said to the fox:
"Everyone is afraid when they see you,

fullTextZH: 你真的是很特别的狐狸，
fullTextEN: you really are a very special fox,

fullTextZH: 很好，现在你知道你错了，
fullTextEN: Very well, now you know you were wrong,
then I will leave, bye bye."

fullTextZH: 你知道这只狐狸很普通，
fullTextEN: You know this fox is very ordinary,

fullTextZH: 那为什么其他动物怕它呢？
fullTextEN: Then why are other animals afraid of it?

fullTextZH: 对，因为狐狸和老虎一起走，
fullTextEN: Yes, because the fox walks with the tiger,

fullTextZH: 其他动物看到它们很害怕，
fullTextEN: other animals are very afraid when they see them,
and run away. They are afraid of the tiger,
But this tiger is quite dumb,

fullTextZH: 它没想到其他动物是怕它。
fullTextEN: It didn't realize other animals were afraid of it.

fullTextZH: 这就是《狐假虎威》的故事。

words.gloss: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might

fullTextEN: This is the story of 'The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might'.

words.gloss: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might

fullTextEN: The Fox Borrows the Tiger's Might,

fullTextZH: 所以它用老虎的力量让大家害怕。
fullTextEN: So it uses the tiger's power to make everyone afraid.

fullTextZH: 现在我看这个故事的时候，
fullTextEN: Now when I look at this story,
I think the fox is very clever.

fullTextZH: 可是我们说一个人“狐假虎威”的时候，
fullTextEN: But when we say someone 'borrows the tiger's might',
It often has a negative meaning
It doesn't mean the person is clever.

fullTextZH: 比如，以前我工作的地方，
fullTextEN: For example, the place where I used to work,
there was a person who bullied others by flaunting powerful connections.
he didn't do his job well,

fullTextZH: 没关系，大家不可以说他不好，
fullTextEN: it's okay, no one could say he was bad,
because he was the boss's friend.

fullTextZH: 现在你会用这个成语了吗？
fullTextEN: Can you use this idiom now?

fullTextZH: 很多说中文的人也不会用成语，
fullTextEN: many people who speak Chinese also can't use idioms,
we also don't use them often.
But you can think about it,

fullTextZH: 你有没有看过狐假虎威的人呢？
fullTextEN: have you ever seen someone who bullies others by flaunting powerful connections?
Please leave a comment and tell me.
